messages:
deploy-bot: Canary alert: prompt-router-v3 (canary group us-west-2) reporting ~48% 5xxs for the last 2m. latency ok. triggering page. :rotating_light:

oncall-maya: got the page, joining. can someone dump canary logs?

sre-lia: looking at logs now — spike in 502s from prompt-mux when routing to /v3/experimental. stack traces show upstream timeouts to prompt-backend-v3.

eng-prod-jordan: rolling trace shows increased error budget used by the canary deployment. suspect routing logic in the new endpoint that does a fallback call. can we flip ff `prompt.v3_route` to safe path?

alice: +1. we should cut traffic back to stable route. LL test showed mismatch on header propagation earlier.

kbarnes: I can flip the flag. will run through the FF API now.

kbarnes: running: 
```
# curl to feature-flag service
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_ADMIN" \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/prompt.v3_route/override \
  -d '{"value":"stable","actor":"emergency-ops","ttl":3600}'
```

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: oncall-maya acknowledged the incident and is the incident commander.

kbarnes: flag change submitted, response 200, new rollout mode=override, target=stable. :white_check_mark:

sre-lia: I can already see error rate dropping in the canary group to ~2-3% in the last 30s. good signal.

oncall-maya: thanks. i'm going to mark the page as routed to engaged team. can someone notify CS about customer impact?

maria: ping CS done — sent a short note: "Some customers in us-west experienced increased 5xxs after a canary rollout for prompt-router-v3. We rolled traffic back to stable route; mitigation in progress."

eng-prod-jordan: quick note on mitigation: we reverted dynamic header passthrough in the routing layer (that change was part of v3 canary). long term: split tests for header behavior and tighter contract checks.

alice: do we have a list of affected customers? metrics shows a handful of high-volume tenants with spike. i'll pull the tenant ids and attach.

kbarnes: attaching tenant list snippet: `tenant-42, tenant-811, tenant-9001` (redacted). CS notified these accounts directly.

sre-lia: running post-flip checks: prefix cache hit rate normal, KV cache ok, no elevated latency. confirming no downstream queue buildup.

oncall-maya: handing off to next oncall (sre-lia) for monitoring window. I'll update the incident doc and start a quick RCA draft. :handshake:

eng-prod-jordan: capturing action items: 1) disable prompt.v3_route by default for canary 2) add contract test for header propagation 3) rollback playbook update for future canaries.

alice: quick customer impact assessment estimate: ~0.03% of total requests, ~1% of revenue for the window — CS already opened support tickets for impacted customers.

kbarnes: will keep the override for 1h and then re-evaluate. if metrics stay green we can run a gated rollout with more telemetry.

sre-lia: thumbs on current dashboards look stable. recommending incident to be declared mitigated.

oncall-maya: marking mitigated. moving to postmortem queue. tagging eng-prod and SRE for follow-up. :white_check_mark: 

eng-prod-jordan: filing a follow-up doc and scheduling a postmortem sync. thanks everyone for quick response.

deploy-bot: Canary group us-west-2 rollback complete, traffic verifying.

pagerduty-bot: Incident update: Severity reduced to S2 — mitigated.

sre-lia: leaving monitoring watch; will escalate if error >5% in next 30m.

kbarnes: closing here unless anyone sees residual issues.

alice: all good from my side. +1 to postmortem and break/fix ticket for the routing change.
